{{Quote|I just attended a party, and I went wild over the host's Fricaseed Puff Cake dessert. I forgot to get the recipe. Can you fetch it from my friend?|An unidentified citizen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Puff cake''' was a dessert. It was a small pastry popular with children.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Puffcake}}</ref>

In [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]], young [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] and [[Reeft]] ate puff cake at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
